inicio.lede: On an astrolabe, the tympan is the engraved plate that fits into the base. The instrument stays the same; you swap the plate for each city. Tympan does this with interfaces: the same components, a theme for each product and each book.
inicio.placaRotulo: Drawing of an astrolabe tympan: horizon, almucantars and azimuth lines
inicio.historiaTitulo: From a folder inside Fakhir to an instrument of its own
inicio.historia1Texto: The components were born inside Fakhir, written from scratch for the platform: accessible, with logical properties and tests from the first file.
inicio.historia2Texto: Colors grow from seeds: brand, neutral, danger, warning, success. The generator computes light, dark and high contrast, and the build fails if any text pair drops below AA.
inicio.historia3Texto: Extracted with the history of the new packages only, Tympan became a Datatech design system. Fakhir became a client; its theme is one plate among others.
inicio.historia4Texto: For data books came the print package: spreads, panels, proof-state marks. Each book style later also became a screen theme.
inicio.placasLede: Pick a theme. The specimen uses each plate's colors, fonts and corners, including the proof-state colors that books use to say what a number supports.
inicio.especimeTitulo: Where the zone arrived before the clean air
inicio.especimeTextoA: Across {n} measurements in Vila Aurora, the low-emission zone has existed on paper since 2022, but the drop in pollution reached no more than
inicio.especimeTextoB: . The panel shows what the data support and what cannot yet be stated.
inicio.camadaTokensTexto: Color, typography, space, radius and shadow as CSS variables and JSON (DTCG format). Works with any technology, including Rust interfaces.
inicio.camadaComponentesTexto: Accessible React: forms, navigation, lists and records, metrics, maps, authentication, the research shell and the flow canvas.
inicio.camadaImpressaoTexto: Static components for data books in PDF and EPUB: spreads, panels, method charts, number tracing and seals.
inicio.principiosTitulo: What stays the same from plate to plate
inicio.principio1Texto: Every theme goes through the same test: text, borders and states against the background, in light, dark and high contrast.
inicio.principio2Texto: Logical properties, so the same component works left to right and right to left. A CI check rejects utility-class frameworks.
inicio.principio3Texto: No component knows which product uses it. What changes from one product to another lives in the theme, never in the component code.
inicio.principio4Texto: The same content produces the same page, which lets you cite a book by the hash of its edition.
inicio.usuarioFakhir: Research platform. Uses the React components with the fakhir plate.
inicio.usuarioAstrlabe: Workflow engine. The Rust interface uses Tympan's tokens and classes, with the astrlabe plate (migration in progress).
inicio.usuarioLivros: Datatech data books. They use the print package and the book styles.
inicio.instalarNota: The token is read-only and comes from an environment variable, never from the repository.

instalar.lead: Three packages: tokens for any technology, React components and print components. All under the FSL-1.1-ALv2 license.
instalar.npmTexto: The packages are private on npm. The token is read-only and comes from an environment variable, never from the repository.
instalar.reactTexto: Import the stylesheet once and wrap the app in TympanProvider (language and routes) and ThemeProvider (theme, mode and density saved in the browser).
instalar.semPiscarTexto: The startup script applies the saved theme before the first paint, so the page never opens in the wrong theme.
instalar.paletaTexto: ThemePalette is the same picker as on this site: fuzzy search across the 43 themes, live preview with the arrow keys, Enter applies and Esc reverts. For the book styles, also import the print theme stylesheets.
instalar.livroTitulo: Data books in PDF and EPUB
instalar.livroTexto: The print package renders on the server, without window or document, and the output is deterministic: the same content produces the same PDF.
instalar.tokensTexto: Without React, use the CSS variables and the data-ty-theme, data-ty-mode and data-ty-density attributes. That is how Astrlabe's Rust interface uses Tympan.
